title: CropWater-RS: Remote Sensing-based Crop Water Requirement and Phenology Toolkit
description: CropWater-RS v2.0.0 is a desktop application for parcel-scale Sentinel-2 NDVI analysis, observation quality control, daily temporal reconstruction, adapted QUANT phenological transitions, crop-coefficient modelling, crop evapotranspiration and simplified net irrigation requirements. It supports project persistence, graphical water analysis and export of reproducible results.
